description: This file contains automated tests for entity-related services within the Apache OFBiz framework. It tests creation, updating, deletion, expiration, and status management of entities such as Testing, TestingItem, TestingNode, and others, by invoking service methods and verifying entity states in the database.

classes.name: ServiceEntityAutoTests
classes.description: A test class extending OFBizTestCase that contains unit tests for entity operations within the Apache OFBiz framework.

methods.name: testEntityAutoCreateSinglPkEntity
methods.description: Tests creation of single primary key entities with specified or auto-generated primary keys, including collision detection.

methods.name: testEntityAutoCreateDoublePkEntity
methods.description: Tests creation of double primary key entities with provided or auto-generated secondary key, including handling of key collisions.

methods.name: testEntityAutoCreateMultiPkEntity
methods.description: Tests creation of multi-attribute primary key entities with explicit or auto-generated parts, verifying correct handling and cleanup.

methods.name: testEntityAutoUpdateEntity
methods.description: Tests updating existing entities by changing attributes and verifying persistence, as well as handling updates with invalid primary keys.

methods.name: testEntityAutoDeleteEntity
methods.description: Tests deleting entities by primary key and verifies proper removal or error handling when entity does not exist.

methods.name: testEntityAutoExpireEntity
methods.description: Tests the expiration (setting of 'thruDate' and specific date fields) of entities and ensures date fields are correctly updated.

methods.name: testEntityAutoEntityStatusConcept
methods.description: Tests creation, updating, and deletion of entity status records, including handling of user login tracking and error conditions.
